admission_order: Attempt all three stated directions, not select by outcomes
source: Official google-research/mt-metrics-eval data; source release identity recorded at acquisition
evaluator_rule: All distinct finite reference-based evaluator streams using the official default reference; require >=8; alphabetical order first seven base, remainder candidates
features: Unchanged seven base scores, consensus-cutoff, range, p/M and intercept
group_rule: All outputs from the same source document in one split; paragraph/source identifiers retained. Human references are excluded as output streams by metadata.
quality_rule: Native MQM only after masks/paths fixed, exact paragraph-system alignment; no label-driven evaluator, source or system selection
missing_rule: No numerical imputation; metadata common system coverage and finite-score rules fixed before analysis; report label missingness without filtering selection by quality
CRC: Only where the original equal-output group control assumptions hold; document grouping with unequal sizes does not automatically transfer its guarantee
new_validation_scope: Not used in this project development according to existing project inventory; not claimed uncontaminated by evaluator training
units: Paragraph-level scores if the official release is paragraph-level; do not call them sentences

reference_priority_numerics.rounding: nearest integer tick, ties to even
reference_priority_numerics.scope: Priority estimates guide acquisition only; observed flip costs, budgets, frontiers and certificate masks stay integer and unquantized.
